Homologous Series: methanol, ethanol and propanol look like three different chemicals, but they are one family. Class 10 Carbon and Its Compounds.

• Same functional group (OH), so similar chemical properties
• Each next member adds one CH2 unit, 14 u more mass
• Same general formula for every member
• Melting point, boiling point and solubility change gradually
